source normalized record facts and first failure

decisions.choice: Separate target-call capture from input/copy/foreign helper calls
decisions.reason: The original observer performs extra constructions that must not be confused with the requested factory route.

decisions.choice: Private protocol before factory-specific custody executor
decisions.reason: Factory owned-value imports/exports require their own surface profile; preserve existing Policy/State Machine profile pins and do not call generic static closure proof native audit.

decisions.choice: Expose finite outcomes per occurrence without requiring false for every validator
decisions.reason: A valid nested Value Object can make a repeated business predicate always true at its containing Entity boundary. Preserve lawful owned inputs; require reached calls and accepted/rejected family diversity rather than fabricate a false witness.

validation: Native positive and invalid lifecycle cases in both configured module roots.
Nested Rules, named Value Object field paths, UInt64, list/set/optional/sum fields and extension ordering where source contracts support them.
Strict-TypeScript-compiling argument, predicate, omitted/duplicate/reordered Rule call mutants that cannot be hidden by reported validator traces.
Exact observation rejection, whole-family sensitivity/capacity, distinct setup versus target calls and unchanged prior semantic regressions.
excluded: This unit does not add the factory family to the private custody executor or public capsule. Independent factory native-surface audit, retained source/artifact/tool custody and public integration remain required follow-on construction. No generator change, database interpretation, Event/provider execution, release or authority.

preliminary_broad_run.reason: Definition, factory controls and tests changed after this run started to repair the demonstrated caller-edge gap. Retained as preliminary evidence; final exact-input 70-test regression is required.

regression_found_and_fixed.fixture: customer's budget Rule has an unreachable nested allowed call; allowed is still reached through customer-valid
regression_found_and_fixed.required_fix: Track source-predicted caller-to-callee import edges, not only visited Rule selectors, and reject whole families with unvisited protocol edges.

known_follow_on.next_required: Correct caller-edge coverage for existing Policy/State Machine protocols before public integration; finite prior positive tests remain historical evidence, not universal edge proof.

development_failures_resolved: Initial extension and capacity fixtures reused a validator Rule across bindings, which the existing planner correctly forbids. Replaced duplicate bindings with distinct source Rules forwarding to the shared budget Rule; generation unchanged.

The first wrong-argument mutant substituted the same 1n value already reached by all selected nested-Money witnesses. Changed the mutant to 2n, a distinct but still-passing argument, to test actual argument observation rather than require a semantically identical observation to fail.

An explicit caller-edge counterexample failed: a shared Rule reached through customer-valid incorrectly covered an unvisited budget-to-allowed import. Added parent-specific source edge visit accounting and whole-family rejection for unvisited edges. The earlier broad run is preliminary because this correction changes bound inputs.

known_policy_follow_on.fixture_change: Forward preserves High's scalar predicate locally while its nested High call is shadowed by true. A second Policy case calls High directly with other input. Thus both Rule selectors are visited while Forward-to-High is not.
